posts.post: people who buy an outfit specifically for one event and never touch it again: are you rich or just allergic to repeating looks?
if you can’t get ready in under ten minutes, your closet is the problem, not your time management.
the ‘i have nothing to wear’ panic usually happens while staring at a closet that is physically overflowing.
you’re either someone who checks the weather report before picking an outfit or you’re someone who enjoys being wet and cold.
